summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Universal Compliance Ingestion Layer (Phase 1-4). All 22 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: Parser Engine (STIG XML, CIS YAML, PCI JSON, Questionnaire JSON), Auto-Mapping Engine (AI-powered using GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key), SIEM Tie-In (correlates controls to SIEM events), Frontend UI (list view, upload flow, detail view with 3 tabs).

seed_data_creation: Created 4 sample checklists via backend tests (STIG, CIS, PCI, Questionnaire). One checklist was auto-mapped using AI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Universal Compliance Ingestion Layer fully implemented and tested. Key features: (1) Parser Engine - POST /api/ingestion/upload parses STIG XML (8 controls), CIS YAML (12 controls), PCI JSON (14 controls), Questionnaire JSON (10 controls). (2) Auto-Mapping Engine - POST /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}/auto-map uses GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key to map ingested controls to existing framework controls (NIST, ISO, SOC2, etc.). Takes 10-30 seconds. (3) SIEM Tie-In - GET /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}/siem-status correlates controls to SIEM events from last 30 days. (4) Frontend UI - Ingestion Layer button on Frameworks page opens list view. Upload flow allows selecting source type and uploading file. Detail view shows stats (total/mapped/unmapped/severity), 3 tabs (Control Graph, Framework Overlaps, SIEM Status), AI Auto-Map button, and delete button. Sample files available at /app/backend/sample_checklists/. Key endpoints: GET /api/ingestion/sample-files, GET /api/ingestion/sample-files/{filename}, POST /api/ingestion/upload, GET /api/ingestion/checklists, GET /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}, DELETE /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}, POST /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}/auto-map, GET /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}/overlap, GET /api/ingestion/checklists/{id}/siem-status.
